描述_EN: the intelligent and alert turn of the horse's head and the energy of its well-muscled body is testament to the immense skill of the tang potter. emperors of the tang dynasty (618-907) kept their horses in special stables and parks that occupied large tracts of land around the tang capital chang'an (present-day xian in shaanxi province). this magnificent tomb figure is proof of the passion the chinese have for beautiful pure-bred horses from the west. important tombs held models of these desirable animals.
描述_ZN: 马的头部聪明而警觉的转动，以及它肌肉发达的身体的能量，证明了唐代陶工的巨大技巧。 唐朝（618-907）的皇帝们把他们的马养在特殊的马厩和公园里，这些马厩和公园占据了唐朝首都长安（今陕西省西安市）周围的大片土地。 这个宏伟的墓像证明了中国人对来自西方的美丽纯种马的热情。 重要的墓葬里有这些理想动物的模型。
